shellCommands.command: git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx"; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cd node_modules/next; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "instant" dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30; cat ../../__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides; cat adopting-partial-prefetching.md; echo =========; cat instant-navigation.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; cat 04-functions/navigation.md | head -150; grep -n "navigation\b\|export declare function navigation\|export.*prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts
